program.name: No-Gear Weekly Mix
program.subject: Weekly mix
program.blurb: A week from every shelf with no equipment, in about thirty-five minutes.
program.about: Every part of the library in a week, on the floor. Bodyweight strength for the whole body, kickboxing bouts, push-ups and floor pulls, a HIIT EMOM, Pilates, a mixed legs day and a mobility day take turns. No two neighbouring days load the same muscles. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
program.split: Full body / kickboxing / upper body / HIIT / Pilates / legs mix / mobility, no equipment
